A '''Weequay marksman''' was an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]<ref name="CCG" /> in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="RotJ" /> A religious Weequay, this marksman used [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] for target practice<ref name="CCG" /> offering them as sacrifices, in accordance with Weequay religious practices. He was present on the top-deck of the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] where he was sliced in half by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Glimpsed only briefly on the top-deck of the ''Khetanna'' during [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], this particular Weequay wears similar clothing to [[Unidentified Weequay guard|another Weequay]] thrown out of the ''Khetanna'' by Skywalker.
